caption.text:
“People love to joke that I’m always on holiday,” says @DuaLipa. “I just make everything I do feel like a holiday.” As she makes a glorious return to the cover of #BritishVogue, the global pop icon takes over the kitchen for the latest episode of Now Serving, and declares: “I’m going to get you all drunk with me.” Hit the link in bio to watch the film in full.

Featuring: #DuaLipa
Director: @Em_McDon_
Director of Photography: @TheHenryGill
Editor: @Evan.Allan
Producer: @HeyItsRashida
Creative Production Coordinator: @AnisaaKennar
Stylist: @LorenzoPosocco
Make-Up: @CeliaBurtonMakeUp
Hair Stylist: @Rio_Hair
Manicurist: @NailsByMH
Food Stylist: @Rez_Rahman_
Florist: @BloomingHaus
Filming Location: @PaperMillLondon
Special Thanks: @PurposeDrivenFoods
